readmeText.message:
conversation.json: Every conversation node and its metadata as returned by the server.
conversation.md / .html / .txt / .docx: A readable version of the selected branch.
gallery.html: A gallery of the images in the chats (if selected).
attachments/: Attachments that were downloaded successfully.
download-report.json: Attachments found, errors and unresolved media pointers.

This extension relies on ChatGPT's unofficial internal data formats. New media/attachment types may not be recognized. A clean report does not guarantee every attachment was found; compare it with the chat. Expired or deleted attachments cannot be recovered.

renderTextDecodeError.message: The text could not be read as UTF-8 or UTF-16 with BOM; the original attachment is in the ZIP.

msgOnlyHint.message: Tick messages one by one; Shift-click to select a range.

pdfNote.message: The PDF opens in a new tab with the print dialog; choose “Save as PDF” as the destination. No server, no limits.

galleryOptionHint.message: Collects every image in the chats (including generated ones) on one page.

obsidianOptionHint.message: Adds YAML frontmatter (title, dates, model, link); the note is named after the chat.

incrementalHint.message: Chats not updated since the last backup are skipped.

folderNote.message: Files are written to the folder you pick (e.g. an Obsidian vault); the existing archive and index are updated. Keep the side panel open.

pageButtonOptionHint.message: Next to the Share button in the chat header; uses your last settings.
